issue.title: ACE definition jump (gd) cannot resolve #ref/<kind> xprompts
issue.description:
Epic sase-ho added the contextual '#ref/<kind>' xprompt namespace (ref/commit, ref/chat, ref/bug, ref/file, ref/bead, ref/agent, plus one generated entry per enabled path-backed sidecar such as ref/plans and ref/research). Completion offers these names and 'sase xprompt show ref/research' renders them, but the ACE prompt-bar definition jump does not resolve them.

Reproduction (workspace on 01fa3b106 plus the sase-ho land fixes):

  .venv/bin/python -c "from sase.xprompt.loader import get_xprompt_or_workflow, get_all_xprompts; print(get_xprompt_or_workflow('ref/research')); print('ref/research' in get_all_xprompts()); print('ref/research' in get_all_xprompts(include_refs=True))"
  -> None / False / True

sase/xprompt/loader.py:378 (get_xprompt_or_workflow) calls get_all_xprompts(project=project) without include_refs=True, so ACE's _resolve_xprompt_jump in src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_prompt_jump_target.py raises JumpError("No xprompt or skill named '#ref/research' found") for every ref name. 'sase xprompt list/show' and the mobile/LSP catalog take a different path (_catalog_sources.gather_entries uses include_refs=True), which is why only the ACE jump surface is affected.

Impact: pressing gd on a '#ref/<kind>' token a user just completed reports the reference does not exist. There is no data loss and nothing regressed -- the namespace is new -- so this is unimplemented navigation rather than a break.

Scope:
- Teach the ACE jump resolver about the ref registry without adding refs to the ordinary expansion catalog. get_all_xprompts(include_refs=True) must stay opt-in: refs are deliberately excluded from the early xprompt pass so '#ref/kind:payload' is rewritten to '@kind:payload' by the late artifact pass instead of rendering early.
- Decide and implement the jump result per renderer source: a real file (project/home/plugin/packaged 'refs/<kind>.md') should open that file; a 'sidecar_ref_config:<role>' renderer should open the owning sase.yml; a 'generated_sidecar_ref:<role>' renderer has no source file and should report that clearly. src/sase/ace/tui/modals/xprompt_browser_helpers.py already classifies both synthesized prefixes as read-only and resolves them to the config file or None (added while landing sase-ho), so the jump path can reuse it.
- Give a 'sase/refs/<kind>.md' file a real category label in classify_source; it currently falls through to the generic 'Other' bucket, unlike sase/xprompts/ and sase/memory/ sources.
- Cover the packaged, project-file, config-backed, and generated cases with tests.

Proposed by the land agent for epic bead sase-ho while verifying that epic's ACE surfaces. Deliberately not folded into sase-ho: the epic's plan (plans:202608/artifact_reference_xprompts.md) scopes definition navigation to 'sase xprompt list/show', the ACE picker, and the LSP catalog, all of which work; the ACE gd surface was never in scope and needs its own small design decision per source kind.
